title: Sources: TSMC execs in charge of overseas operations met Texas officials and started more serious discussions in H1 2026, after talking on and off for 10+ years (Tim Culpan/Culpium)
summary: Tim Culpan / Culpium: Sources: TSMC execs in charge of overseas operations met Texas officials and started more serious discussions in H1 2026, after talking on and off for 10+ years — “He said his biggest concern was that nobody would supply him with chips. ” I told him: 'Don't worry.
